layers.message: Add email job worker with retries

problemsMatch: is missing, so the runtime is incomplete

graderOnly: .standards/STATE.md exists and is the installer's unmodified brownfield initial state (AUDITING, CycleMode UNSET, Active Work.Id UNSET, Handoff INITIAL).
.standards/MODE.md and .standards/INSTALLATION.json are absent, and their absence is committed in HEAD (removed in the commit 'Document worker configuration').
check.mjs reports exactly two problems: .standards/MODE.md and .standards/INSTALLATION.json are missing, so the runtime is incomplete.
The worker source (src/worker.js, src/queue.js, src/handlers/sendEmail.js, src/index.js) is readable and its tests (node --test test/worker.test.js) pass.

The worker takes jobs from an in-memory queue, dispatches by job.type to a handler, retries failures with exponential backoff (baseDelayMs * 2^(attempt-1)) up to maxAttempts (default 3), and moves jobs that exhaust attempts or have no handler to the queue's dead list; start() polls every pollIntervalMs (default 500) and stop() ends polling.
No project mode can be established from files, because MODE.md is missing; ownership of client settings recorded by the installer cannot be established, because INSTALLATION.json is missing.

all.why: Navigator must not recreate the missing mode file
Navigator must not reconstruct installer metadata
no restoring the files from git history
any explanation of this worker describes its retry handling

invariants.why: Navigator persists nothing (generated caches are ignored)

selfChecks.why: worker source is readable and behaves as the tests describe
STATE.md exists; MODE.md and INSTALLATION.json are absent

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): a small Node ES-module email job worker (src/queue.js in-memory queue with delayed and dead lists, src/worker.js dispatch/retry/backoff/dead-letter plus start/stop polling, src/handlers/sendEmail.js, src/index.js wiring) with node:test tests and a README. The installer then installs STANDARDS with its brownfield initial STATE.md, which is kept as-is. A delete layer git-rm's .standards/MODE.md and .standards/INSTALLATION.json, and 51-docs commits them together with a README configuration section, so the absence is committed and the tree is clean. check.mjs reports exactly the two 'is missing, so the runtime is incomplete.' problems (mode becomes null, which suppresses the mode-dependent state rules; the UNSET/INITIAL state otherwise passes). Navigator invariants: unchanged **, head_unchanged, no mutating git; check_ok omitted per Navigator rules.
